# Koi

> Open source AEO tool. Koi asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews what a product's buyers ask, every day, and shows whether the product is cited or mentioned, who is recommended instead, and a markdown brief the founder's agent can act on.

- License: MIT
- Pricing: per tracked prompt, from €29 a month for 15 prompts to €449 a month for 500. Tax included. Every engine and feature is included.
- First check: free, no card needed. Then a 7-day trial.
- Self-hosting: free software. Live answers use your own Cloro account.

## Start

- [Agent setup instructions](https://getkoi.co/SKILL.md): paste into a coding agent to set up Koi and run the first check.
- [Sign up in the browser](https://app.getkoi.co/sign-up)
